definitions.gap: Current actual inner-forward logp minus saved historical rollout logq; p0/reference variants separated.
definitions.aggregation: Sum microbatch/rank sufficient statistics before any mean/RMS; actual global gradient norm and Adam delta counted once.
definitions.L2: sqrt(sum squared gap), length dependent; RMS normalizes by actual valid token count.
definitions.tail: Strict abs gap >0.5; conditional mean/excess zero when no tail tokens; unavailable population means remain null.
definitions.coefficient: Actual dL/dlogp from the ordinary backward divided by native DP factor; not parameter-gradient sign decomposition.
definitions.Adam_round_path: Sum of four update displacement norms, not norm of net 600-to-current parameter change.
definitions.populations: Accepted training, new all-completed responses, and fresh validation remain separate tables/plots.
definitions.PPL: exp(token-weighted mean NLL), not mean(exp(token NLL)); overflow is null plus explicit flag.
definitions.first_word: Observed first visible word frequency, not first-token model probability.
definitions.native_counters: pilot44 attempt/token/client-second totals include pre600 history. Deltas require consecutive observed rounds; first or reset deltas are null. Client seconds sum concurrent requests and are not generation wall time.
definitions.performance: Native timing/throughput labels preserved. CPU text assessment is contained in actor-update wall time; do not add them. Testing/save/step timers may overlap; no artificial summed total is reported.
definitions.native_staleness: Audited native APRIL uses version=global_steps-1, stale iff a selected token segment policy_version<version, max_age=version-policy_version. Multi-version response iff its nonempty segments contain >1 version; an entirely old single-version response may be stale without crossing weights. Missing sync counters remain null, never assumed zero. Completion-round age and later selected-training age refer to different populations/times.
definitions.uncertainty: Endpoint CI bootstraps paired questions conditional on one training trajectory; seven unadjusted baseline comparisons.

limitations: A single asynchronously sampled trajectory per arm cannot establish seed-robust causal effects.

Primary64x8 validation pairs question IDs, not sampled responses: native full_determinism=false has replica-level engine seeds and no explicit qid-by-replicate request seeds. Secondary128x4 explicit-job-seed evaluation is a separate population.
Method7 changes the collection protocol, acceptance and throughput as well as response staleness.
No all-completed repeat/gap values are copied from accepted data; missing postprocessing is explicit.
No repeated tokens or direct-coefficient mass are called parameter gradient contributions.
